steps.en: Install the compiler, or the integration for the bundler you already use
steps.zh: 安装编译器，或你已在用的打包器对应的集成

steps.en: Write .mdx: Markdown plus imports, exports and JSX in the prose
steps.zh: 写 .mdx：Markdown 加 import、export 与 JSX

steps.en: remark-mdx parses the MDX syntax and the document becomes an AST
steps.zh: remark-mdx 解析 MDX 语法，文档变成一棵 AST

steps.en: Compiles that AST into a JavaScript module
steps.zh: 把这棵 AST 编译成一个 JavaScript 模块

steps.en: Build it through your bundler, or evaluate it directly
steps.zh: 经由你的打包器构建，或者直接求值

steps.en: Your framework renders it with the components you imported
steps.zh: 由你的框架用你 import 进来的组件完成渲染

value.en: Prose and live application components compile into one tree, with no parallel copy of the content to maintain
value.zh: 正文与实时的应用组件编译进同一棵树，不必再维护一份平行内容

sources: readme.md (MDX example: import {Chart} from './snowfall.js', export const year = 2013, '{year}', <Chart year={year} color="#fcb32c" />; 'an authorable format that lets you seamlessly write JSX in your markdown documents'; packages for compiling to JavaScript, integrating with webpack and Rollup, and using it with React, Preact and Vue)

packages/mdx/readme.md (npm install @mdx-js/mdx; ESM only, Node 16+; compile/compileSync/createProcessor/evaluate/evaluateSync/run/runSync API list; 'if you're using a bundler ... you're better off using an integration')
